name: release-readiness
description: Workflow kiểm tra Viezan trước release: product smoke tests, security/local-first audit, i18n, build/test/package và docs

classification.use_for: Gate a release with product smoke, package, security, i18n, test, build, and docs checks.

trigger: Khi chuẩn bị release, build bản phân phối hoặc kiểm tra trước khi tag/publish

gates.name: Product smoke test
checks: Text translation works with at least one configured provider
Rewrite/detect/style path still works
Live translation can start/stop and cleanup audio resources
Subtitle overlay can open/close if enabled
Image translation accepts paste/drop and returns/downloads result
AI Chat sends message and restores history
TTS and STT settings render and fail gracefully without key
History tabs load and search works
Chrome Extension popup opens, shows provider/model state, translates typed text, copies result and handles app offline/token invalid states
Chrome Extension options saves token, default target language and translation style
Chrome Extension selection tooltip appears near selected text, clamps in viewport, re-translates on language/style change, copy/replace/listen actions work

gates.name: Chrome Extension UX
checks: Popup, Options and selection tooltip share visual language
No emoji action/status icons in chrome-extension UI
No decorative inline SVG provider/action badges in popup.js/content.js
Missing token, connecting, active, offline, loading, copied, replaced and TTS failed states are visible and recoverable
Floating button and tooltip do not shift host page layout

gates.name: Security and local-first
checks: No raw API key exposure to renderer/preload
No new unapproved data egress
External URLs are allowlisted
IPC inputs are validated
No committed secrets

gates.name: i18n completeness
checks: New UI text has VI/EN/JA translations
Translations type compiles
No visible hardcoded labels in changed UI components unless intentional user content

gates.name: Automated tests
checks: Unit tests pass
IPC tests pass
Store tests pass
Component/page tests pass where changed

gates.name: Package build
checks: Electron build passes
Vite build passes
macOS/Windows build command selected for target release
Updater and artifact config reviewed if version changes

gates.name: Docs and release notes
checks: README/docs updated for user-visible feature
viezanagent docs/prompts updated if agent workflow changed
CHANGELOG.md has the exact package version entry with features, fixes and limitations
README review fingerprint matches the exact source and docs being released; never refresh it without reviewing the diff

steps.name: Xác định release scope
steps.action: Xem version, diff, changelog/release notes dự kiến và target OS.

steps.name: Chạy từng gate
steps.action: Chạy product smoke checklist, security workflow, i18n check, tests và build/package command phù hợp.

steps.name: Phân loại blocker
steps.action: Critical security, build failure, broken core translation/live/chat/image path là blocker.

steps.name: Sửa hoặc báo cáo
steps.action: Sửa blocker trong scope; nếu không thể, ghi rõ nguyên nhân và command/log liên quan.

steps.name: Kết luận readiness
steps.action: Trả bảng Gate/Status/Notes, Blocking Issues và Commands Run.
